inner_partition: same three-fold splitting algorithm; fixed split seed, model seeds perturbed

conformal.rule: Composition-group-disjoint proper/calibration split inside each official outer train. Full selection uses proper set only; no reuse of old hyperparameters selected with calibration labels.

common_pool: RF, ET, CatBoost on old and D representations, identical candidate budgets and selection recipes; reuse original OOF and outer predictions

external.training: Full matbench_glass only; frozen V4 procedure; no external-label tuning
external.exclusion: Remove exact fractional composition matches (8 decimals). Primary also removes min L1 distance <=0.02. Keep duplicate measurement rows; bootstrap by composition.
external.evaluation: Primary separated composition subset; secondary all nonexact-overlap; per-system results. Threshold .5, no external calibration.
external.caveat: Sputtering versus bulk/melt-based source conditions: external domain-shift stress test, not identical-condition replication. Does not validate all five tasks externally.

caveat: All five official datasets have been inspected in earlier versions. No claim of fresh blind validation for these five. SE gate is a heuristic.
